project_title: The DOM Serialization Gap: Architectural Pruning, Information Loss, and Observation Confounds in Autonomous Browser Agents
design_name: Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD) / Stratified Multi-Arm Design

arm_definitions.ABS: Baseline variant with standard HTML visible typography; semantic attributes absent.
arm_definitions.ARIA: WAI-ARIA markup variant; semantic labels attached to buttons and landmark elements.
arm_definitions.DATA-CFG: Developer-defined data-* attribute variant (e.g. data-action, data-product-id).

inference_specification.primary_estimand: Stratified risk difference (RD) between treatment arm (ARIA, DATA-CFG) and reference arm (ABS) across 5 task strata, evaluated via Mantel-Haenszel weighting with Sato and Greenland-Robins variance estimators.
